behavior.replayLease: pending, failed, or publishing rows whose lease expired and whose next_attempt_at is due can be reclaimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; stale workers cannot complete a replacement lease.
behavior.replayCrashWindow: A crash before publish or after publish but before completion leaves a reclaimable lease. A later relay may publish again with dlq-replay-v1:<originalEventId>; consumers must deduplicate that stable key.
behavior.durableIdentity: Parent and outbox retain the composite original event, request, publisher key, and canonical body hash FK. claimOutbox recomputes the shared deterministic canonical JSON hash inside its transaction and rolls back on mismatch; relay independently fails closed before publish.
behavior.ecsConcurrency: Dispatcher ReservedConcurrentExecutions=1 is the hard Lambda worker boundary. SQS event-source MaximumConcurrency remains 2 because AWS does not accept 1. Before RunTask the worker checks project PENDING and RUNNING tasks; any existing task blocks another launch.
behavior.ecsCrashBoundary: Canonical UUIDv7 requestId is both SNS FIFO deduplication ID and ECS clientToken. Tasks carry Project, HardDeadlineSeconds, and RequestId tags; duplicate ingestion in the FIFO five-minute deduplication window does not enqueue a new task request.
behavior.ecsStop: StopTask retries three times and polling must observe STOPPED; failure is surfaced through ReportBatchItemFailures.
behavior.migrationGate: Prepare preserves raw short-form tags and re-describes the live change set before approval. Final deploy consumes the approved finalTemplateSha256, copies the current template into a private read-only frozen file, verifies it twice, rejects all extra arguments, and deploys only that frozen path.
behavior.pauseResume: The first pause snapshot is immutable and ownership-bound. priorDispatcherConcurrency must be the JSON integer 1; unreserved, 0, and values above 1 fail before any mutation. pausing/resuming steps use exact-old-state, SSM version, and write-readback checks for idempotent continuation.
behavior.hmac: HMAC timestamp and signature validation remains before JSON parsing. A canonical UUIDv7 requestId drives SNS FIFO and SQS FIFO deduplication for five minutes; secret retrieval or validation unavailability fails closed.
behavior.repositoryPolicy: Static token parsing skips a finite allowlist of AWS global/service flags and value options before cloudformation and its mutation action. --no-paginate, --cli-auto-prompt, and --no-cli-auto-prompt are supported boolean flags. Any unknown option before a statically visible action reports fail-closed; dynamically concatenated command names remain out of scope.
